gamerule.scp3199MaxPopulation.descriptio: SCP-3199 eggs stop hatching, and instances stop laying, once a dimension holds this many. 0 or less stops all SCP-3199 breeding.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp3199.title: SCP-3199 Humans, Refuted
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3199_spawn_egg: SCP-3199 Humans, Refuted: tall, pale, featherless things that walk like birds and hunt like wolves. Keter-class.
They attack people, villagers and animals on sight. A single instance dies about as easily as a person does.
One instance is rarely the problem. Instances left alone in one place do not stay alone for long.
They swim well and do not need to come up for air.
It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp3199.0: Something pale is close, and it is not patient.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.title: Humans, Refuted
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.caption: SCP-3199 photographed through the observation port. The pale objects on the floor were not there the day before.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.0.text.0: SCP-3199 instances are held in a sealed chamber with thick steel walls. The chamber is to be kept bare, and nothing is to be stored inside it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.0.text.1: Instances are to be counted at every shift change. **Any change in the count is to be reported at once,** whether or not anyone saw it happen.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.0.text.2: In the event of a breach, the affected wing is to be sealed and flooded. %rSee Protocol 34-22-B.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.1.text.0: SCP-3199 is a species of tall, hairless, pale creature that walks upright on two bird-like legs. Its skin is thin and waxy, its neck is long and unusually flexible, and its short arms end in hooked claws.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.1.text.1: Instances hunt anything that moves: people, livestock and wildlife alike. They are fast, but no harder to kill than a person.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.1.text.2: Instances that settle in one place for long enough begin to multiply. Staff have described the process as distressing to watch and to listen to.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.2.title: Addendum 3199-A: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.2.text: The first instance was recovered from woodland after reports of a "bald" animal. By the time the recovery convoy reached the site, it was no longer the only one. %rThe convoy crew asked not to be told how.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.3.title: Addendum 3199-B: Inspection Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.3.text: Cleaning staff report hard, pale lumps on the chamber floor that throb faintly when the room is quiet. More are found each week. Staff are not to linger near them.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.4.title: Addendum 3199-C: Disposal
dossier.scp_unleashed.3199.page.4.text: Conventional disposal has failed. Fire, impact and blades left the problem exactly where it was. %rOnly one corrosive method has been approved. The method is restricted.%r
jade.scp_unleashed.scp3199.settled: Settled in, pacing the same few steps
